literal_meaning: ওলা (ফোলা বা উত্তোলন) এবং ওঠা (উঠা বা উদগম)
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে জলের অভাবে ওলা-ওঠার প্রাদুর্ভাব ঘটেছে।
তার শরীরে ওলা-ওঠার লক্ষণ দেখা দিয়েছে, দ্রুত চিকিত্সা করানো দরকার।
example_sentences_in_english: Cholera broke out in the village due to water scarcity.
He showed symptoms of cholera; he needs immediate treatment.
history: This term originates from historical cholera pandemics in Bengal during the 19th century, linked to British colonial times and poor sanitation in rural areas.
Cholera outbreaks were rampant in Bengal due to the Ganges river contamination and famines.
note: The idiom is a colloquial euphemism for cholera, reflecting symptoms like abdominal swelling and dehydration.
